## Declared by

| instance | directory | path | holds | what it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cat-harness` | `health` | `test/health/results` | `health` | Repository health reports — what the daily sweep under `test/health/` wrote. One `health-report/v1` document, declaring itself with a `$schema` tag rather than being duck-typed by path: a directory is a PLACE TO LOOK and the files inside say what they are. A SEPARATE graph from `qa`, and the line between them is about the SUBJECT, not the producer: a QA verdict judges an artefact this repository produced, against criteria that artefact is supposed to meet; a health report judges the REPOSITORY ITSELF — how big it has grown, how much of the publish branch the review previews occupy, whether the work plan has duplicates in it. Folding it into `qa` would leave a consumer asking for verdicts about this instance's content holding a fact about its clone. NOTE the path: it was `tests/health/results/` when this graph landed in #395, because this repository then had BOTH `test/` (the `qa` graph) and `tests/` (the Playwright e2e specs), and the owner asked for `tests/health`. #395 flagged that inconsistency in `skills/kg/kg-core/directory-conventions.md` rather than resolving it, since relocating a declared directory as a side effect of adding a check is the `dh4f` shape, where a consumer scans nothing and reports a clean run over it. The owner settled it on `test/` the same day and it moved as its own change — bean `auap`, PR #400. The `id` here is unchanged, deliberately: an inheriting instance overrides on the entry's id and never on its path, so `health` still binds after the relocation. The e2e specs came to the declaration rather than the declaration to the specs, because `testDir` is one line of one config file and a declared path is what every downstream override resolves against. |
